title: Smart Home Security Guide 2026: Complete Setup
description: Build a complete smart home security system for under $200. Cameras, sensors, and automation explained.
keywords: smart home security, home security system, smart security cameras, home automation security
content:
You can build a complete smart home security system for under $200. Here's how.

Essential Components

  • 2-3 security cameras ($30-50 each)
  • Door/window sensors ($10-20 each)
  • Motion sensor ($15-25)
  • Smart doorbell ($30-60)

Recommended Setup

Front door: Wyze Doorbell ($35). Living room: Blink Mini 2 ($30). Back door:

>Wyze v4 ($36). Total: $101.

Automation Ideas

Set cameras to turn on when motion is detected. Get alerts when doors open. Record clips when someone rings the doorbell.

No Subscription Required

Wyze offers free local storage. Blink offers live view without subscription. You don't need monthly fees.
